shots.what: Hook: the postman walks along the village road, trips over a stone (stumble, arms out); the lens glides past him
The lens rises behind him over the hedge and reveals the finished stone palace in the sun
1879: wide of the hilly valley, fields and a village; the young postman walks his round, posts a letter into a mailbox and walks on
Low close-up: a strangely shaped stone (a little animal) on the path; his feet walk in and stop; he bends down
He picks the stone up (hand on his arm) and puts it into his jacket pocket
Next morning: more odd stones on the path, he smiles and opens his arms
Calm glide over the village rooftops and fields (follow-button sentence, lower third calm)
Walking on with pockets bulging with stones; then pushing a wheelbarrow full of stones along the path (wheel turns)
Night: he builds the first low wall by the light of an oil lamp, trowel and stone
Pull back to a wide: alone in the dark garden with the lamp
Villagers at the garden fence whisper, one taps his forehead, one laughs
The postman looks into the lens and shrugs
Time-lapse: walls and towers grow, seasons change (autumn leaves, snow, spring), his beard turns grey
The finished palace: glide along the facade, stone animals, the temple, the giant figures
The old postman looks lovingly at his palace; an official in a dark suit shakes his head and wags his finger
Village cemetery by day: the old man builds a small tomb in the same style between plain gravestones
Today: visitors with cameras in front of the palace; the monument plaque with a star
Outro: calm slow rise over the palace in the evening sun (logo + button overlay)
